dashboard.heroSubtitle: AgriRent AI connects farmers with nearby tractors, harvesters and implements — matched by a model that understands your crop, land and schedule.
dashboard.processTitle: Three steps from field to finish
dashboard.step1Desc: Tell us your crop, operation, land size, location and date — guided, not a form.
dashboard.step2Desc: Our ML model ranks nearby equipment by fit, availability, distance and price.
dashboard.step3Desc: Confirm in a tap, then track your equipment from dispatch to field.

trust.claimSub: {{equipment}} · deposit ₹{{deposit}}. Nothing is deducted without evidence and an answer.
trust.disputeHoldNote: This claim is disputed, so nothing is being deducted. The disputed amount is held; the rest is released.
trust.claimOpenNote: The renter has {{hours}} hours to agree or dispute this claim.
trust.fileClaimSub: You have {{hours}} hours from the return report to file a claim. After that the deposit is released and the machine's record closes.
trust.estimateRequired: For amounts of ₹2000 or more, attach the repair estimate photo — an amount without a paper trail is what disputes turn on.
trust.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Left rear tyre cut during ploughing; needs replacement.
trust.claimEvidenceNote: Return report {{code}} is attached as evidence.
trust.noEstimateAttached: No repair estimate is attached to this claim.
trust.negotiateHint: If part of it is fair, you can agree to a smaller amount.
trust.disputeConsequence: Disputing holds the amount without deducting it, and keeps the evidence frozen for review.
trust.disputedBody: Nothing is deducted while this is disputed. Both parties' photos and the app's checks stay frozen as evidence.
trust.disputedStep1: 1. Compare the handover and return photos in the report.
trust.disputedStep2: 2. Agree an amount between yourselves if you can — most disputes end here.
trust.disputedStep3: 3. If not, AgriRent review uses the record: the photos, the fingerprints, the meter and the flags.
trust.offlinePaymentNote: Payment happens directly between the two of you (cash or UPI); this record is the agreement and the receipt.
trust.settledPending: Both parties agreed — record the settlement to close this.
trust.windowOpenRenter: The owner has {{hours}} hours after the return report to raise a damage claim. Nothing can be deducted before they do.
trust.windowClosedRenter: The claim window has passed. If no claim was filed, the deposit is released in full.
trust.needReturnFirst: A return condition report is needed before any deposit question can be settled.
trust.knownDamageNote: Damage listed here was recorded earlier and can never be charged to you.
trust.claimDescriptionRequired: Describe the damage in a line.
trust.withdrawnNote: Withdrawn by the owner — no deduction.
trust.verifyNotFound: No report found with this code
trust.verifyNotFoundSub: Check the code on the report. If it still doesn't work, the code may be mistyped or the report was never filed.
trust.verifyIntactSub: All {{count}} recorded entries still match their fingerprints. Nothing has changed since the report was finalized on {{date}}.
trust.verifyIntactDraftSub: All {{count}} recorded entries still match their fingerprints, but this report has not been finalized and is not a verified condition report.
trust.verifyBroken: The record history does not match its fingerprints
trust.verifyBrokenSub: The fingerprint chain doesn't match. Treat the contents with caution and contact AgriRent.
trust.verifyFooter: Checked against the database record ({{source}}). Photos are private to the two parties and are not shown here.
trust.historyVerifiedCount_one: {{count}} signed condition report on record — every rental here is photographed and signed by both sides.
trust.historyVerifiedCount_other: {{count}} signed condition reports on record — every rental here is photographed and signed by both sides.
trust.estimateHint: Photograph the mechanic's estimate or bill
trust.estimateWhy: A claim of ₹2,000 or more needs the estimate on record — this is the rule that stops a number being argued about later.
trust.estimateUploadFailed: The estimate photo couldn't be saved. Please try again.
trust.recheckHint: Uses the photos already stored — nothing to retake. Worth doing if the automatic reading didn't come back the first time (the free server can be asleep).
trust.verifyUrlLabel: Anyone can verify this report at
trust.orSignByHand: You can also sign by hand (optional — the statement above is what is recorded).
trust.err_storage_blocked: Upload blocked — you may not be a party on this booking, or the session expired.
trust.err_bucket_missing: Evidence storage isn't set up yet. Please tell the AgriRent team.
trust.err_photo_too_large: The photo was too large for storage. Try retaking it.
trust.err_network_dropped: Network dropped during upload — your photos are still here, tap retry.
